As Mplx LP (MPLX) Share Price Declined, Holder Heronetta Management LP Increased Its Position; Saturna Capital Has Trimmed Its Tjx Companies (TJX) Holding by $995,296 as Share Price Rose 
April 16, 2018 - By Nellie Frank 
Heronetta Management Lp increased its stake in Mplx Lp (MPLX) by 5.75% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Heronetta Management Lp bought 15,100 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.11% with the market. The institutional investor held 277,937 shares of the natural gas distribution company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $9.86M, up from 262,837 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Heronetta Management Lp who had been investing in Mplx Lp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $26.08B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.61% or $0.2 during the last trading session, reaching $32.42. About 1.05M shares traded. MPLX LP (NYSE:MPLX) has declined 6.29% since April 16, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 17.84% the S&P500. 
Saturna Capital Corp decreased its stake in Tjx Companies (TJX) by 1.78% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Saturna Capital Corp sold 13,096 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.50% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 721,805 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $55.19M, down from 734,901 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Saturna Capital Corp who had been investing in Tjx Companies for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $50.96B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.54% or $1.27 during the last trading session, reaching $81.26. About 3.95 million shares traded. The TJX Companies, Inc. (NYSE:TJX) has risen 2.67% since April 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 8.88% the S&P500. 
Saturna Capital Corp, which manages about $3.98B and $3.27 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 6,379 shares to 627,602 shares, valued at $106.21 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Sensata Technologies Holding (NYSE:ST) by 7,222 shares in the quarter, for a total of 12,412 shares, and has risen its stake in Oracle (NYSE:ORCL). 
Analysts await The TJX Companies, Inc. (NYSE:TJX) to report earnings on May, 15. They expect $1.02 earnings per share, up 24.39% or $0.20 from last year’s $0.82 per share. TJX’s profit will be $639.62 million for 19.92 P/E if the $1.02 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.37 actual earnings per share reported by The TJX Companies, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -25.55% negative EPS growth.
